The candidate repository cannot select signer bytes or digest, access authority secrets, execute the signer, or replace the authority workflow; targeted static and mutation tests plus the complete canonical gate pass.

findings.summary: Snapshot verification accepts threshold signatures without enforcing the exact TrustRole.scope, allowing a mismatched authorized role to satisfy the snapshot threshold.
findings.resolution: Snapshot verification now calls scoped DSSE verification with the exact canonical snapshot:<network> scope derived from the authenticated import network before any mutation. Dedicated wrong-scope and cross-network signed-role integration tests pass, and C028-D14 executes the real integration-test path.

findings.summary: The commit-pinned external reusable signing workflow is unreachable from the public candidate caller, so the production signing handoff is not operationally usable.
findings.resolution: Production signing moved to an accessible same-repository workflow_run authority whose definition is taken from the protected default branch. It rejects fork runs, failed or stale candidate runs, workflow name/path spoofing, candidate checkouts, caller-supplied signer authority, digest or bytes, and unsigned artifact-name/release mismatches; targeted mutations and the complete handoff policy pass.

findings.summary: Release installation has a crash window after filesystem mutation but before the durable journal phase records the mutation, permitting incomplete or ambiguous recovery.
findings.resolution: Installer recovery now reconciles the durable journal against retained filesystem effects before phase advancement. Targeted 14-case release verification and five Python drill tests cover mutation-before-phase process death and prove deterministic completion or rollback without ambiguous publication state.

findings.summary: C028 schema validation can be bypassed, and not every C028 schema is authenticated through the central registry and mutation coverage.
findings.resolution: The gate now validates all five C028 documents with authenticated Draft 2020-12 schemas, registers every schema plus the schema regression suite in the central manifest, rejects unknown fields and coordinated schema/document drift, and executes 30 mutation guards.

findings.summary: The publish workflow interpolates expected_release_id into shell commands without first rejecting shell metacharacters, permitting command injection through workflow input.
findings.resolution: The publish workflow validates the release identifier against the strict canonical character policy before privileged steps or shell interpolation, removes untrusted expressions from shell source, and rejects malicious metacharacter inputs in targeted signing-authority tests.

findings.summary: The signer emits c028-workflow-metadata-v1 while the publish validator requires obsolete c028-workflow-candidate-v1, so the authenticated production handoff cannot validate its own output.
findings.resolution: The signer and publisher now produce and validate one exact c028-workflow-metadata-v1 schema with candidate/signing run and protected workflow bindings. All 22 metadata/schema/authority tests and the complete ten-command C028 gate pass.

findings.summary: Container restart verify-install trusts a mutable unsigned receipt and installed-file state without re-authenticating them against the signed release manifest and externally provisioned trust root.
findings.resolution: Restart verification now re-authenticates the signed manifest and candidate bundle under the externally provisioned trust store, channel, verification time, and sequence floor before checking receipt and installed bytes. Release-verifier tests, the live materialized container restart drill, and the complete ten-command C028 gate pass.

findings.summary: The Solidity Compose profile also starts the unprofiled FullNode and collides on host ports; the canonical container drill masks the production failure by explicitly selecting only the Solidity service.
findings.resolution: Assigned both FullNode and Solidity services to explicit mutually exclusive Compose profiles, removed the implicit default node, and changed the canonical R21 container case to inspect the complete profile-selected service set. Full selects only FullNode, solidity selects only Solidity, no profile selects no node, six focused container tests pass, and the complete ten-command C028 gate passes.

findings.summary: Bootstrap ignores snapshot_policy.max_payload_bytes and enforces only the broader runtime payload cap, allowing an authenticated snapshot to exceed its configured snapshot-specific limit.
findings.resolution: Bootstrap now computes one validated effective snapshot payload cap as the stricter nonzero minimum of runtime_limits.max_snapshot_bytes and snapshot_policy.max_payload_bytes, rejects limits that cannot fit the platform size type, and passes that cap to SnapshotSource before authentication or import. Three focused limit tests, two bootstrap tests, nine deployment tests, and the complete ten-command C028 gate pass.

findings.summary: Compose accepts simultaneous Full and Solidity profiles instead of rejecting the conflicting dual-node host-port configuration.
findings.resolution: Added a single-mode Compose launcher that requires exactly one of full or solidity before invoking Docker Compose; dual-mode, empty-mode, and direct ambiguous profile selections are rejected, with focused container regressions and the complete ten-command C028 gate passing.

findings.summary: The release-candidate workflow runs the canonical gate and builds without explicitly provisioning the pinned Rust 1.85.1 toolchain.
findings.resolution: The candidate workflow now installs, overrides, and verifies the exact pinned Rust 1.85.1 toolchain on the fresh runner before the canonical gate and release build; workflow regressions and the complete ten-command C028 gate pass.

findings.summary: The publish workflow reruns the complete C028 gate without provisioning the authenticated pinned BusyBox material required by native release assembly.
findings.resolution: The publish pre-secret validation job now provisions authenticated pinned BusyBox package and material inputs for the complete gate rerun, while the privileged publish job receives no BusyBox executable; workflow regressions and the complete ten-command C028 gate pass.

findings.summary: Snapshot descriptor loading calls fs::read before checking max_manifest_bytes, allowing unbounded allocation from an oversized descriptor.
findings.resolution: Snapshot descriptors are now opened with retained no-follow descriptors, validated as bounded regular single-link owner-only files before allocation, read through a max-plus-one bounded loop, and revalidated against descriptor and pathname identity; sparse-oversize and substitution regressions plus the complete ten-command C028 gate pass.

findings.summary: Candidate and signer workflow release-ID validation lacks the 128-character upper bound enforced by the authenticated schema and publish workflow, permitting inconsistent release identity acceptance across trust boundaries.
findings.resolution: Candidate, signer, and publish workflows now enforce the exact schema-aligned 1..128 canonical release-ID regex before artifact assembly, secret provisioning, or privileged operations. Exact 1/128 acceptance and empty/129/noncanonical rejection regressions pass, the central gate hash is synchronized, and the complete ten-command C028 gate passes.

findings.summary: The offline release verifier accepts an arbitrary manifest release_id and uses it as a filesystem path component, bypassing the canonical 1..128 release identity contract and permitting unsafe path construction.
findings.resolution: The offline verifier now validates the manifest release_id through the canonical schema-aligned 1..128 release identity type before deriving any installation path. Exact traversal, empty, 129-character, noncanonical, and 1/128 boundary regressions pass; the release drill hash is synchronized and the complete ten-command C028 gate passes.
